title: 后羿射日
description: 十日并出，后羿不是射杀太阳，而是用箭劝退过量的光，教会人间'刚刚好'的哲学

visualStyle.style: 写实东方奇幻史诗，阿凡达式明亮光影
visualStyle.subStyle: 卡梅隆式自然奇观 + 爱死机级情感精度
visualStyle.color: 金色日光与焦土褐红的极致撞色，玄冰箭的幽蓝微光
visualStyle.mood: 温柔而震撼的史诗感，拒绝暴力，突出'刚刚好'的东方哲学

shots.action: tracking shot following a single Light Mother rising from Spiral Giant tree trunk, dolly in on six luminous serpents pulling light vehicle across Nirath sky, golden bioluminescent rays cascading through violet mist, close-up of crystal light refraction on serpent scales, floating spore particles dancing in golden light, hyperrealistic skin texture on serpents, subsurface scattering on scales

aerial shot of Nirath dawn breaking over bioluminescent grassland, wide shot of luminous crops stretching upward with crystal dew drops, tracking light cycles shifting across landscape, dolly in on golden spore particles floating in gentle morning breeze, close-up of twin moons fading into soft blue sky, hyperrealistic grass texture, subsurface scattering on dew drops

wide shot of ten tribal elder sons mounting light vehicles simultaneously, tracking Many Lights bursting into Nirath sky, whip pan across ten blazing golden trails splitting sky, close-up of heat shimmer radiating downward, dolly in on crystal ground cracking under intense light, slow motion of violet mist burning away, hyperrealistic skin texture on sons, subsurface scattering on golden trails

wide shot of cracked crystal ground spreading across scorched plain, tracking shot of Luminath River boiling, close-up of Chinese boy 8yo green jacket pushed into crystal shelter, dolly in on small hand gripping crystal shard, scared wide eyes looking back at burning sky, hyperrealistic skin pores visible, subsurface scattering on crystal glow

low angle of Valnir hunter on Violet Deep crystal peak, dolly in on Biobow strapped across back, close-up of head looking up at Many Lights blazing, tracking wind blowing through dark hair, hyperrealistic skin pores visible, subsurface scattering on crystal dust

close-up of Valnir hunter eyes widening with compassion, rack focus from trembling teenage silhouettes at center of each Light Mother to gentle sorrow on weathered face, dolly in on bow hand slowly lowering, tracking shot of understanding dawning in brown eyes, hyperrealistic skin pores visible, crystal light reflecting off tear forming in corner of eye in slow motion

slow motion of Valnir hunter drawing crystal Biobow to full draw, tracking first arrow loosing with cyan streak trail, whip pan across sky cutting golden light thread, close-up of bowstring vibrating with crystal resonance, determined gaze tracking arrow flight, hyperrealistic skin pores visible, subsurface scattering on arrow glow

tracking shot following struck Light Mother slowly descending back toward Twin Moon Canyon, aerial shot of golden bioluminescent rain falling across cracked crystal plain, dolly in on luminous crop sprouts emerging from dry ground, close-up of golden light droplets reflecting twin moons, rack focus from gentle mercy to crystal surface healing, hyperrealistic raindrop texture, subsurface scattering on golden light

handheld cam of Valnir hunter loosing second and third crystal arrows in rapid succession, tracking shot following each arrow with cyan glow, whip pan across sky severing golden light threads, close-up of bow hand steady with compassion, spore particles trailing behind shots, hyperrealistic pores visible, subsurface scattering on cyan glow

dolly in on smallest Light Mother hovering stubbornly in sky, close-up of flickering with defiant golden pulse, tracking shot of longest shadow across Violet Deep peak, rack focus from tiny trembling form visible at its center to hunter standing below understanding its fear, hyperrealistic light particle texture, subsurface scattering on golden pulse surface

low angle of Valnir hunter setting Biobow down, tracking shot climbing Spiral Giant tree upward, dolly in on reaching hand toward blazing Light Mother, close-up of palm open with gentle offering, bark glowing bioluminescent under fingers, hyperrealistic pores on hands, subsurface scattering on tree glow

tracking shot following tenth Light Mother slowly descending into Twin Moon Canyon, dolly in on golden light softening to gentle warm glow, close-up of bioluminescent rays becoming balanced and kind, rack focus from crystal walls reflecting perfect luminance to twin moons welcoming their companion home, hyperrealistic crystal surface texture, subsurface scattering on balanced light

overhead shot of crystal shelter cover pushed open from above, dolly in on warm balanced light streaming down onto Chinese boy 8yo face, tracking dust motes dancing in golden beam, close-up of amazed wide eyes looking up, rack focus from gentle light touching cheek to shadow of mother's silhouette at opening, hyperrealistic skin pores visible, subsurface scattering on light beam

wide shot of Valnir hunter kneeling on Violet Deep shore, dolly in placing Biobow into crystal sand, tracking shot of Chinese boy 8yo watching beside, rack focus from luminous crop sprouts pushing upward to both peaceful faces, hyperrealistic pores visible, subsurface scattering on crystal sand

time-lapse aerial shot of arrow-shaped trees growing from Biobow burial site, dolly in on straight crystal-white trunks reaching upward, tracking shot of leaf undersides covered with bioluminescent dew drops, close-up of crystal energy melted into nourishing moisture, rack focus from new forest canopy to twin moons shining through, hyperrealistic tree bark texture, subsurface scattering on bioluminescent dew

tracking shot following grown Chinese young man kneeling in light grass field, dolly in measuring Light Mother shadow with crystal tools, close-up of content smile on weathered face, shadow marking time precisely, sun on schedule, warm light touching shoulder, Hangzhou badge glinting, hyperrealistic pores visible, subsurface scattering on crystal tools
